analysis: Complete BASE period census for second-round IS-only research
accounting: Fixed initial USD 100000, additive daily spot PnL, zero costs
positive_definition: Strictly greater than 1e-10 percentage points; descriptive sign only, not a performance threshold
persistent_definition: Positive simple return in each of IS_EARLY, IS_MIDDLE and IS_LATE; no statistical independence or future-persistence claim
late_definition: IS_LATE is the prewritten 2020-01-01 through 2023-05-29 block; no observations beyond IS_END are used
sorting: Account rows ordered pair, strategy; strategy and family summaries alphabetically, never by performance

family_definition.behavior_family: Rule mechanism label: mean reversion, momentum, trend following, breakout, ensemble, fixed regime filter

limitations: All observations are in-sample descriptions, not a screen for the next round.
Currencies and related rules are correlated; positive-account counts are not independent statistical trials.
Full-IS trade quality and each period entry/close cohort do not sum across periods.
A filter improving a negative BASE may repair historical losses without creating persistent absolute returns.
Behavior families are recorded from fixed rule identifiers, not selected from observed returns.
